reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Release Notes Blog Post: For a detailed breakdown of the key changes and improvements in this release, check out the official blog post", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: This is a reference to release documentation with no operational consequence; operators need not take action based on this entry alone

proposed.statement: This change is a reference to external documentation (a blog post), not a product change in Argo CD itself.
